macau-2023.notes: Source 2 (Codeforces gym standings) is the Universal Cup Stage 15 board: 171 teams, of which about 86 rows are named 'Institution - team' and match the regional's teams (e.g. Peking University 9 solved, 1443), mixed with Universal Cup teams; the board ranks them together, so I agree with the earlier reader that it is not the regional's own scoreboard. Source 1 also holds a one-page Chinese registration notice with no text layer that I could not read (no Chinese OCR); the description of it rests on the home page's link and a partial OCR.

sources.evidence: Home page titled 'The 2023 ICPC Asia Macau Regional Contest' with 'Date: Nov 18-19, 2023' and 'Venue: University of Macau', plus links to the standings, team list and invitation letter PDFs.

The Codeforces gym is titled 'The 2023 ICPC Asia Macau Regional Contest (The 2nd Universal Cup. Stage 15: Macau)' and its 171-team table is led by USA1 and HoMaMaOvO, with the regional's teams only embedded as 'Institution - team' rows among Universal Cup teams.

Three-page DOMjudge scoreboard print headed '2023-2024 International Collegiate Programming Contest, Macau Site final standings' with columns rank, team, score and problems A to K, each cell with minutes and tries.
Three-page DOMjudge scoreboard print with the same heading as the official-teams print, listing 92 team rows and an Observers category with asterisked team names alongside Participants.
Table of 82 ranked teams with columns Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time, Medal and Citation, headed 'The 2023 ICPC Asia Macau Regional Contest', with no per-problem columns.
Three-page table with columns Team Name, University, Coach and Seat ID listing 82 teams with seat numbers 1 to 82.
23-page PDF whose cover reads 'The 2nd Universal Cup, Stage 15: Macau, December 23-24, 2023' and whose problems A to K carry the same titles as the regional's problem list.
Codeforces gym dashboard titled 'The 2023 ICPC Asia Macau Regional Contest (The 2nd Universal Cup. Stage 15: Macau)' with a table of 11 problems A to K matching the regional's problem list.
Six-page PDF headed 'Stage 15: Macau, The 2nd Universal Cup, Dec 23-24, 2023' with one 'Problem Tutorial' section for each of the 11 problems A to K.
